family.name: Ghouls
family.lore: The parish buried its dead in a hurry the year the bell cracked. Some of them noticed.

monsters.name: Gnawling
monsters.desc: A stunted ghoul, hunched so low its knuckles scrape the ground. Hunger has worn it to sinew and teeth, and it still wears the grave linen it was buried in.
monsters.answer: Fight them in a doorway, or catch the whole crowd in one blow.

monsters.name: Grave Ghoul
monsters.desc: It digs with its hands because it has forgotten what a spade is for.
monsters.answer: When it crouches, the marked tile is where it lands. Be somewhere else.
